thag3.14:1.2: to the world of the hungry ghosts;
thag3.14:1.4: in the pain of the animal womb;
thag3.14:2.2:
went to heaven
from time to time;
thag3.14:2.3:
settled in the elements of form,
the elements of formlessness,
thag3.14:3.1:
Ways of taking birth
are now known:
devoid of essence,
thag3.14:3.3:
Knowing them
as born from my self,
thag3.14:3.4:
mindful
I went right to peace.
